added: > media shows what's playing with its cover, a seek bar, play / pause / skip and a live visualizer
> weather shows the temperature and sky for your country, with animated icons (only the country is used, nothing more precise)
> clock (time, date and a calendar), > system (CPU, memory, graphics, storage), > network (download and upload speed only)
> timer 5m and > stopwatch, with a chime and a notification when time's up
The time, the weather and what's playing sit on the right of the empty bar; click one to open it
Type math (12*7.5), units (5 km in mi) or money (20 usd in eur) and the answer shows on the bar; Enter copies it
Web shortcuts: g cats, yt lofi, w rust and more (> searches to see them all or add your own)
> windows, > emoji, > clip (clipboard history, kept only in memory), > f to find files, > kill to close an app
> note and > notes, > volume, > brightness, > wifi, > bluetooth, > dark
> lock, > sleep, > restart, > shutdown and > signout ask again before they go ahead
> theme new makes your own theme; > sounds, > layout (position, width, corners, animation) and > hotkey
Put scripts or apps in the Commands folder (> commandsfolder) and each becomes a > command
> caret changes the text cursor: 12 colors (or Rainbow), a soft, strong or pulsing glow, and effects
Effects when typing (Sparkle, Confetti, Bubbles), deleting (Explosion, Shatter, Dust) and moving (Glide, Trail, Comet)
Every caret card plays its effect, and the selected one is tried out on the real caret
Downloaded fonts are listed first in > font, under Downloaded
Scroll bars can be dragged, or clicked to jump
> font opens a font picker: 477 free fonts with a preview of each, sorted into categories (SF Pro first, then Sans Serif, Serif, Monospace, Math, Symbols & Emoji and fonts for other languages)
Fonts are only downloaded when you click their Download button, and are used right away
> font NAME searches the fonts, and every font has a clean name ("SF Pro Display Black Italic", not "SF-Pro-Display-BlackItalic.otf")
> fontfolder opens the Fonts folder in File Explorer; fonts you put there show up under On this PC
Use default font switches back to the Windows font
Setup sees a new version as soon as it's released
Setup and Settings > Apps show the version that's really installed
Long lines in the update list wrap, and the list scrolls
Your pinned apps from the Windows Start menu now sit above the command bar, each with its name under the icon
Drag pinned apps to reorder them; right-click to hide or unpin them, and type > pins to show hidden ones again
Right-click any app for Run as administrator, Open file location, Pin to Start and Pin to taskbar
> games lists the games on all your drives (Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, Xbox, Riot, EA and more) and starts them
Typing a program's name finds it, so "cmd" brings up Command Prompt
Opens on top of fullscreen games, and Esc hands the keyboard back to the game
Use your own font: put a .otf or .ttf file in the Fonts folder where Custom Start is installed
Hardware acceleration option in Setup (on by default): Custom Start draws on your graphics card
Game mode: Custom Start steps out of the way while a game or other fullscreen app is running
Mouse and keyboard handling runs on its own high-priority thread, so it never adds input lag
Update prompts wait until you finish playing
Command bar that replaces the Windows Start menu (Windows key, Ctrl+Esc or the Start button)
Smooth open and close animation with an animated, gliding caret
Frosted backdrop that fades out at the edges
Themes: Dark, Light, Translucent, Glass, Midnight, Sunset, Mint and OLED (type > theme)
Expanded results: matching apps listed under the bar while you type
Choice of C++ or Rust backend
CSMInstaller with automatic updates from GitHub
